label: H.R. 5348
title: Social Security Child Protection Act of 2025
short_title: Social Security Child Protection Act of 2025

latest_action.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Finance.

summary: Social Security Child Protection Act of 2025 This bill directs the Social Security Administration to issue a new Social Security number to a child under the age of 14 if the child's Social Security card was lost or stolen while being mailed to the child.
summary_short: Social Security Child Protection Act of 2025 This bill directs the Social Security Administration to issue a new Social Security number to a child under the age of 14 if the child's Social Security card was lost or stolen while being mailed to the child.
